text.en:
Any provision of law, decree, executive order, administrative order, letter of instruction, or rule
and regulation to the contrary notwithstanding, all provinces, cities, and municipalities are hereby authorized
to grant their employees whose salaries or wages are less than six hundred pesos (P600.00) per month, or its
equivalent if on the daily basis, emergency cost-of-living allowances in addition to their respective salaries or

The amount granted shall cover only the difference between the actual salary received and the
rate of six hundred pesos (P600.00) a month, but in no case shall the monthly allowance exceed fifty pesos
If there are fund limitations, the salary ceiling of those that would be benefitted may be reduced from six
hundred pesos (P600.00) per month to a lower rate, and the amount of the allowance adjusted accordingly.

The grant of said allowances may be retroactive as of February 18, 1974, the date of effectivity
of Presidential Decree No. 390, subject to the availability of local funds.

The appropriations for said emergency allowances shall not be included in the computation of
the maximum salary percentages fixed under Republic Act No. 4477 for provinces and cities and Republic
Act No. 2638 in the case of municipalities.

The Secretary of Finance and the Secretary of Local Government and Community Development
shall utilize the facilities of their respective departments in ensuring the uniform application of the provisions
of this Decree and shall promulgate the rules and regulations necessary for effective implementation.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 8th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
